pivot: centre of the threshold on the ground; the gate faces -Y in Blender (Unity +Z after the FBX axis conversion): the giant walks out towards -Y

Open.note: the first and only opening; rumble 0-30 (camera shake, dust off the voussoirs), crack: the knot collapses and four seal shards fly (flash + shard burst at Seal), first light: the seams open (raise the emission and a point light inside), the petals swing back bottom first; spawn the giant in the flash at first_light or when fully open

Opened_Idle.note: stays open for the rest of the level

emission: magenta glyph grooves, jamb seams, petal rims and sigil, crystals; suggested _EmissionColor strength 0.6 while closed (dormant), ramp to 2.5 from first_light to fully_open, then 1.6
